Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Head of Cloud Alliances to lead business development and partnerships with the global public clouds. As the publisher of Ubuntu, Canonical is already a trusted partner with the leading guest OS and select services for the major hyperscalers. We have a large portfolio of open source software on the cloud marketplace for enterprise customers, and are looking to expand our global cloud partnerships.

Reporting to the VP of Global Alliances, the Global Head of Cloud Alliances will lead teams that bring innovation to the public cloud platforms, joint go-to-market with public cloud sales communities and marketplaces, and our global customer and partner contracts. They will work closely with cloud partners, from engineering to product management and marketing, to deliver open source solutions at scale for their cloud customers.

Our Cloud Alliance team builds trusted relationships with partners at all levels, from joint technical work to executive strategy. Their goal is to increase Canonical market share in the cloud ISV ecosystem, develop cloud channel sales, evangelize the partnership and lead all business interactions. The Global Head of Cloud Alliances will own the strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with all cloud partners, as well as promotion of our cloud related activities - from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and cloud related events.

Our company is largely distributed, this role can be based anywhere in the Americas or EMEA.

The role entails

  • Taking ownership of Canonical's global cloud partner strategy, leading efforts to forecast, driving bookings, and growing revenue worldwide
  • Building strong, cross-functional relationships across teams to ensure a unified approach to technology and market execution
  • Inspiring and guiding teams to achieve accelerated revenue growth with Cloud partners, continually refining and evolving strategies for success
  • Establishing and nurturing executive-level relationships with key partners, laying the foundation for long-term success and mutual growth
  • Steering our offering from concept to execution, aligning product management and marketing strategies while scaling success through our global sales organization

What we are looking for in you:

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Exceptional leadership and presentation skills, capable of energizing teams and stakeholders while delivering compelling data-driven narratives
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • An in-depth understanding of open source technologies, Ubuntu, and the competitive ecosystem, with an eye for identifying opportunities that others might miss.
  • Autonomous, disciplined, and proactive—take ownership, and deliver exceptional results

Nice to have

  • A track record in alliance and indirect sales management, with an ability to build partnerships that drive success
  • Solid experience in the Public Cloud sector, coupled with an understanding of the evolving landscape of technology and innovation.
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Senior Security Operations Engineer role at Canonical

Continue with Google Continue with Google

3 months ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Senior Security Operations Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

We have opened several senior/staff Security Operations Engineer (SOC) positions, creating a new team reporting to the CISO. We are looking for a range of experience in these positions - at the high end we are looking for deep experience defending highly contested critical assets and high-value cyber targets against advanced persistent threats and state-level actors. We have more junior roles for exceptional individuals with a proven personal interest an engagement in cyber attack and defence, and outstanding academic and career performance even if experience is limited.

Our goal is to build an entirely new level of assurance and observable rigour into the open source supply chain. We have our own estate to monitor, but more broadly our goal is to raise the robustness of the entire global Ubuntu estate through the work of this team.

The Security Operations (SecOps) team is responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.

The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

What you will do in this role:

  • Implement and evolve Canonical's Security Operation Center
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Previous professional experience working or leading a Security Operation Center
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Expertise in threat modelling and risk management frameworks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF and ISO27001

Optional things we value

  • Experience in a security operations team or a security operations centre (SOC)
  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with state-actor and other advanced persistent threats

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Enterprise Project Manager
description:

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Enterprise Project Manager

Canonical's mission is to streamline and accelerate the adoption of open source across the entire global enterprise technology market. Our customers embrace the Canonical approach to open source for complex projects on bare metal, on the cloud, and at the edge. Canonical Enterprise Project Managers are responsible for ensuring project success through owning, driving, communicating and respectfully engaging all stakeholders, valuing integrity and accountability.

Within a portfolio of projects with complex and changing software technologies, customer and partner satisfaction is only possible because of exceptional Project Managers who know how to respect and engage all stakeholders.

Location: This is a Globally remote role.

The role entails

  • Ensuring programs and projects are delivered within the schedule, scope, cost, budget and resources expectations
  • Identifying key technical and project risks and issues and actively put mitigating actions in place
  • Maintaining strong customer focus and working with all key stakeholders to achieve successful outcomes
  • Conducting regular status meetings and business reviews with customers and providing direction when needed
  • Managing the delivery schedule of critical third party deliverables for the project
  • Advocating to customers the appropriate technologies from Canonical's portfolio
  • Driving project success while managing risks

What we are looking for in you

  • Experience in Enterprise IT Programs, Process Improvement, and Software Engineering Project Management
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Experience leading cross-cultural, remote and global project teams and customers.
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills
  • Strong communication skills
  • Deep understanding of Linux, Open Source, and Cloud Technologies
  • Bachelor's Degree in a STEM discipline
  • Project Management Certification, preferably PMP or equivalent certification
  • Agile Project Management certification, preferably Scrum Master or equivalent certification
  • Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. title: TÉCNICO DE IMOBILIZAÇÃO ORTOPÉDICA - REDE HOSPITAL CASA - CLT
description:
Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica - Rede Hospital Casa - CLT

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:
  • Assumir o posto de serviço conforme escala, devidamente identificado, uniformizado e com aparência pessoal adequada;
  • Identificar corretamente o paciente antes de realizar o procedimento;
  • Preparar paciente para procedimentos de imobilização ortopédica;
  • Preparar material para confeccionar as imobilizações;
  • Preparar sala para pequenos procedimentos fora do centro cirúrgico, como pequenas suturas e anestesia local para manobras de redução manual, punções e infiltrações;
  • Observar o tipo de imobilização a confeccionar, as condições do paciente, seguindo orientações e prescrição médica;
  • Confeccionar imobilizações e aparelhos gessados nas salas de gesso e cirurgia;
  • Confeccionar imobilizações com material sintético, aparelhos gessados, goteiras gessadas, esparadrapagem, talas digitais (imobilização para os dedos), enfaixamento, tração cutânea, colar cervical, entre outros, conforme prescrição médica;
  • Retirar aparelhos de imobilização ortopédica, conforme prescrição médica;
  • Utilizar de forma adequada equipamentos como serra elétrica vibratória;
  • Realizar procedimentos específicos em imobilizações ortopédicas, como a abertura de janelas no aparelho gessado;
  • Manter sala de imobilização organizada;
  • Zelar pela limpeza da sala, bem como organização e preservação e guarda de materiais e equipamentos de uso na sua especialidade;
  • Auxiliar o médico ortopedista em procedimentos ortopédicos não cirúrgicos, como na instalação de trações esqueléticas e manobras de redução manual;
  • Realizar lançamento e registro em prontuário dos procedimentos realizados e materiais utilizados;
  • Promover orientações pertinentes e de conservação da imobilização aos pacientes;
  • Auxiliar a equipe multidisciplinar em imobilizações de pacientes vítimas de trauma ou que necessitem de restrição total de movimento;
  • Obedecer às normas técnicas da Sociedade Brasileira de Ortopedia e Traumatologia (SBOT), às normas internacionais para confecção de imobilização, normas regulamentadoras de Segurança do Trabalho e o Código de Ética Profissional;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda e qualquer ocorrência administrativa;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda ocorrência durante atendimento ao paciente;
  • Participar de treinamentos institucional e setorial quando solicitado sua participação;
  • Cumprir as normas e regulamentos da Instituição, bem como as rotinas operacionais da sua Unidade;
  • Respeitar e conhecer os instrumentos normativos do setor como instruções de trabalho.
Esperamos que você tenha:
  • Ensino médio completo com curso técnico em imobilização ortopédica.
  • Registro no conselho de Classe.
  • Desejável experiência anterior de 06 meses.
  • Noções básicas de Primeiros Socorros a pacientes vítimas de trauma, Higiene ocupacional, biossegurança e ergonomia, equipamentos e Materiais ortopédicos.
  • Noções de Ortopedia e Traumatologia.
Conheça os benefícios que oferecemos para você:
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Refeição no Local;
  • Convênio Médico;
  • Convênio Odontológico;

description:
Associate Solutions Architect – TestBox

Remote — Must be based in Rio de Janeiro or Niterói

$36,000 USD / year + equity & benefits

About TestBox

TestBox was founded with a bold mission : to fundamentally transform how software is bought and sold. We're building an innovative platform that empowers buyers with transparent, interactive software experiences, while equipping sellers with powerful tools to deliver exceptional buying and onboarding journeys. Our core technologies—synthetic data, intelligent orchestration, and our unique product graph—help teams achieve faster implementations, clearer insights, and increase trust with their customers.

At TestBox, we're not just improving demos; we're building the next generation infrastructure for software transactions, creating seamless experiences from initial interest to successful onboarding and beyond.

We're a fast-growing startup built by a team that values experimentation, velocity, and customer impact. We're backed by world-class investors and are building a platform that's disrupting the traditional B2B sales motion.

Role Overview

As a Solutions Architect at TestBox, you'll be at the heart of our customer experience—designing, building, and delivering high-impact demo and POC environments that drive sales success for our customers.

You’ll lead technical delivery, participate in agile rituals like standups and retros, and act as a trusted consultant to help customers design stories that resonate. You’ll also be expected to innovate and move fast—this isn't a role for someone looking to just “follow the playbook.”

To succeed here, you’ll need to be curious, flexible, and scrappy. You’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and go-to-market teams, and you’ll use AI tools (including our own) daily to boost your productivity, generate data, and solve complex problems creatively.

Key Responsibilities Project Ownership & Delivery
  • Lead end-to-end implementation of customer demo and POC environments—from kickoff through delivery.
  • Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and retros; communicate blockers and drive timelines forward.
  • Collaborate across customer engineering, solutions, and product teams to ensure smooth handoffs and clear technical execution.
Customer Storytelling & Consulting
  • Help customers craft compelling demo narratives grounded in real-world buyer personas, workflows, and industry context.
  • Design fictional yet realistic companies and user journeys to simulate how the product solves specific problems.
  • Advise on best practices for demo structure, content pacing, and emotional resonance.
Environment Implementation
  • Configure CRM, support, or comms tools with customized fields, workflows, and industry templates.
  • Simulate real user behavior using automation, time-based triggers, and behavioral scripting. (We integrate AI-powered interactions where relevant to enhance realism)
AI-Driven Efficiency
  • Leverage AI tools (including LLMs like OpenAI and Anthropic, automation platforms) to speed up data generation, ticket writing, and documentation.
  • Continuously explore ways to innovate and disrupt traditional workflows using AI—TestBox is built on this mindset.
Documentation & Ticket Writing
  • Create detailed technical tickets and documentation to support repeatable environment setup and engineering handoffs.
  • Maintain internal knowledge resources for templates, industry scenarios, and technical edge cases.
Who You Are
  • You're fluent in english.
  • You're resourceful, autonomous, and outcomes-driven —comfortable leading projects with limited structure.
  • You think like a builder, act like an owner, and communicate like a product manager.
  • You thrive in startups : ambiguity excites you, pivots don't scare you, and you prioritize speed over perfection.
  • You believe AI is a power tool , not a novelty—and you're already using it to make your work better and faster.
  • You're comfortable translating between customer needs and technical systems, and enjoy being at the intersection of product, engineering, and sales.
Preferred Qualifications
  • 3–5 years in Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, Implementation, or similar technical consulting roles.
  • Ability to write and manage technical tickets and documentation for delivery teams.
  • Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, and data formats like CSV and JSON.
  • Experience working in agile environments (standups, retros, ticket grooming, etc.).
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, text‑to‑speech engines, automation platforms) to drive efficiency, draft technical documentation, create demo content, or solve complex problems.
  • Bonus : Familiarity with synthetic data or interactive storytelling in demos. Completion of AI‑focused courses, certifications, or hands‑on projects.
Why Join TestBox
  • Shape the future of how software is bought and sold.
  • Build with a team that values autonomy, curiosity, and experimentation.
  • Use AI every day—not as a gimmick, but as a core productivity engine.
  • Make a direct impact in a high-growth startup redefining the demo experience.
Benefits
  • Generous equity package for meaningful ownership
  • Prioritization of your professional growth, with dedicated career development support
  • Flexible, unlimited PTO with a minimum expectation for recharge
  • Mental Health benefits
  • Fitness allowances
  • Learning allowances
  • Remote and office setup allowances to ensure productive and comfortable working environments

description:
Overview

As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology.

Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

We convert audience attention into action through data, machine learning, and continuous optimization.

We’re hiring a Machine Learning Engineer (Recommendation Systems) to build the personalization engine behind our portfolio of brands. You’ll design, deploy, and scale ML systems that power real-time recommendations across millions of user journeys. This role gives you the chance to work on systems serving 100M+ predictions daily, directly impacting engagement, retention, and revenue at scale.

MUST HAVE

You’ve shipped large-scale ML systems into production that power personalization at scale. You’re fluent in ranking algorithms and know how to turn data into engagement and conversions. Specifically:

  • 7+ years building and scaling production ML systems with measurable business impact
  • Strong background in ranking algorithms (collaborative filtering, learning-to-rank, deep learning)
  • Proficiency with Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch)
  • Skilled with SQL and modern data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) plus data lakes
  • Familiarity with distributed computing (Spark, Ray) and LLM/AI Agent frameworks
  • Track record of improving business KPIs via ML-powered personalization
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms and experiment logging best practices
YOUR ROLE

Your mission: Drive business growth by building and optimizing the recommendation systems that personalize experience for millions of users daily. You’ll own the modeling, feature engineering, data pipelines, and experimentation that make personalization smarter, faster, and more impactful.

OUTCOMES
  • Build and deploy ML models serving 100M+ predictions per day to personalize user experiences at scale
  • Enhance data processing pipelines (Spark, Beam, Dask) with efficiency and reliability improvements
  • Design ranking algorithms that balance relevance, diversity, and revenue
  • Deliver real-time personalization with latency <50ms across key product surfaces
  • Run statistically rigorous A/B tests to measure true business impact
  • Optimize for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency in production
  • Partner with product, engineering, and analytics to launch high-impact personalization features
  • Implement monitoring systems and maintain clear ownership for model reliability
COMPETENCIES
  • Technical Mastery: You know ML architecture, deployment, and tradeoffs inside out
  • Experimentation Infrastructure: You set up systems for rapid testing and retraining (MLflow, W&B)
  • Impact-Driven: You design models that move revenue, retention, or engagement
  • Collaborative: You thrive working with engineers, PMs, and analysts to scope features
  • Analytical Thinking: You break down data trends and design rigorous test methodologies
  • Ownership Mentality: You own your models post-deployment and continuously improve them
  • Execution-Oriented: You deliver production-grade systems quickly without sacrificing rigor
  • Curious & Innovative: You stay on top of ML advances and apply them to personalization

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

title: Consultor de vendas

Overview

Tudo o que fazemos é por acreditar que existe um grande potencial não explorado em cada ser humano. Nosso propósito é transformar a vida das pessoas ao descobrir sua melhor versão. Somos o melhor curso de comunicação e oratória do Brasil; ajudamos pessoas e empresas a melhorarem suas performances e resultados através de uma metodologia única e inovadora que combina técnicas de oratória, fonoaudiologia, neurociência, psicologia positiva e técnicas teatrais.

Nossa cultura: No nosso dia a dia, nos propomos a fazer diferente na vida dos nossos clientes e colaboradores de forma única e eficiente, porque acreditamos que cada ser humano é único e tem grande potencial a ser descoberto e desenvolvido. Isso se tangibiliza em atitudes práticas e em nossos valores:

  • Excelência: Ter compromisso por fazer o melhor, sempre. Valorizar o cuidado com os detalhes e a busca constante pela alta qualidade em tudo o que faz.
  • Coragem: Encarar as mudanças e desafios de frente, com confiança e determinação, acreditando que cada adversidade é uma oportunidade para o crescimento e transformação.
  • Inovação: Inovar com paixão e estar sempre em busca de novas ideias e soluções que tragam resultados impactantes, transformando vidas.

Seus Principais Objetivos São:

  • Qualificar e desenvolver os leads gerados por nossas estratégias de marketing;
  • Atualizar as informações no CRM e softwares de sales engagement com pontos relevantes sobre as oportunidades identificadas;
  • Trabalhar o social selling e aprofundar relacionamento com os leads por meio de canais sociais.

Procuramos por Pessoas (atentem-se às soft skills abaixo):

  • Pessoas com raciocínio lógico;

  • Ótima dicção;

  • Visão sistêmica;
  • Solucionadoras de problemas;
  • Criativas e empreendedoras;
  • Organizadas e disciplinadas para contribuir com a performance do time;
  • Que AMEM trabalhar em equipe (aqui não aceitamos egoísmo, nem competições não saudáveis);
  • Resilientes e Pacientes (confortáveis no desconforto e lidando com o desconhecido);

  • Que tenham espírito empreendedor.

Diferenciais:

  • Noções básicas de inglês; Experiência como SDR;
  • Conhecimento prévio na metodologia SPIN Selling;
  • Conhecimento de CRM.

Pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas em todas as nossas oportunidades. :)

@lojayoucom

Somos a Youcom e a gente AMA moda! Há mais de 10 anos nasceu a maior marca especializada em moda jovem do país, entregando uma experiência omnichannel, com qualidade e preços incríveis. Hoje, contamos com quase 150 lojas físicas espalhadas por diversos estados do Brasil, além de um e-commerce e app que atende todo o país.

A gente acredita na moda como uma ferramenta de expressão. Nosso negócio é movido por paixão, criatividade e estilo. Acreditamos na diversidade e somos protagonistas da transformação que queremos deixar no mundo. Nosso time tem autonomia e abrimos espaço para que o aprendizado seja constante no dia a dia.

Se o que te encanta é poder aprender, compartilhar e ensinar. Se o que te encanta é o respeito, a diversidade e a inclusão. Esse é o jeito Youcom de fazer e o seu lugar é aqui. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito: Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito: Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência. Valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, e comprometemo-nos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos.

Diversidade e inclusão: A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Construímos a cada dia uma cultura baseada no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Atender as normativas do Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN);
  • Registrar junto ao Conselho de classe (COREN) a responsabilidade técnica da unidade;
  • Compor Comissões como as de prontuário e PGRSS;
  • Supervisionar e garantir o cumprimento das atividades de sua área e participar das atividades integradas com as demais áreas;
  • Avaliar e acompanhar a produtividade de enfermagem de acordo com os parâmetros estabelecidos;
  • Realizar o dimensionamento do quadro de pessoal da equipe de enfermagem para a qualidade na assistência prestada;
  • Realizar reuniões periódicas com a equipe de enfermagem para discussão técnicas e administrativas e também ações corretivas e educativas, motivadas pelas não conformidades identificadas nos registros de assistência;
  • Assegurar que a assistência de Enfermagem seja prestada seguindo os preceitos de segurança, de forma humanizada e individualizada;
  • Avaliar periodicamente o nível de qualificação técnica dos empregados de sua responsabilidade e manter o controle sobre a assiduidade e disciplina dos mesmos;
  • Participar da elaboração das rotinas dos serviços de enfermagem em conjunto com o Gestor bem como mantê-las atualizada;
  • Supervisionar o cumprimento de normas e recomendações estabelecidas pelo Controle de Infecção Hospitalar nos serviços de saúde colaborando para o controle de infecção;
  • Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem.
  • Experiência mínima de 02 (dois) anos comprovada em Gestão de equipe de Enfermagem.
  • Especialização Completa em Gestão Hospitalar, Gestão de Saúde, ou áreas afins.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Trabalho 100% presencial;
  • Local de trabalho: Centro do Rio;
  • Step 3: Avaliação 3 Avaliação

description:
Lead Machine Learning Engineer, Recommendation Systems

Join to apply for the Lead Machine Learning Engineer, Recommendation Systems role at Launch Potato

4 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState.

As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology.

Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

We convert audience attention into action through data, machine learning, and continuous optimization.

We’re hiring a Machine Learning Engineer (Recommendation Systems) to build the personalization engine behind our portfolio of brands. You’ll design, deploy, and scale ML systems that power real-time recommendations across millions of user journeys. This role gives you the chance to work on systems serving 100M+ predictions daily, directly impacting engagement, retention, and revenue at scale.

MUST HAVE
  • 7+ years building and scaling production ML systems with measurable business impact
  • Experience deploying ML systems serving 100M+ predictions daily
  • Strong background in ranking algorithms (collaborative filtering, learning-to-rank, deep learning)
  • Proficiency with Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch)
  • Skilled with SQL and modern data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) plus data lakes
  • Familiarity with distributed computing (Spark, Ray) and LLM/AI Agent frameworks
  • Track record of improving business KPIs via ML-powered personalization
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms and experiment logging best practices
YOUR ROLE

Your mission: Drive business growth by building and optimizing the recommendation systems that personalize experience for millions of users daily. You’ll own the modeling, feature engineering, data pipelines, and experimentation that make personalization smarter, faster, and more impactful.

OUTCOMES
  • Build and deploy ML models serving 100M+ predictions per day to personalize user experiences at scale
  • Enhance data processing pipelines (Spark, Beam, Dask) with efficiency and reliability improvements
  • Design ranking algorithms that balance relevance, diversity, and revenue
  • Deliver real-time personalization with latency <50ms across key product surfaces
  • Run statistically rigorous A/B tests to measure true business impact
  • Optimize for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency in production
  • Partner with product, engineering, and analytics to launch high-impact personalization features
  • Implement monitoring systems and maintain clear ownership for model reliability
COMPETENCIES
  • Technical Mastery: You know ML architecture, deployment, and tradeoffs inside out
  • Experimentation Infrastructure: You set up systems for rapid testing and retraining (MLflow, W&B)
  • Impact-Driven: You design models that move revenue, retention, or engagement
  • Collaborative: You thrive working with engineers, PMs, and analysts to scope features
  • Analytical Thinking: You break down data trends and design rigorous test methodologies
  • Ownership Mentality: You own your models post-deployment and continuously improve them
  • Execution-Oriented: You deliver production-grade systems quickly without sacrificing rigor
  • Curious & Innovative: You stay on top of ML advances and apply them to personalization

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Example Projects You Might Own

A Engenharia Clínica é a área responsável pela gestão do parque de Equipamentos Médicos do Centro de Diagnóstico do Grupo Fleury. title: Strategy Consultant Sr
description:
Por que a Valtech? Somos uma experience innovation company — um parceiro de confiança para as marcas mais reconhecidas do mundo. Para quem faz parte da Valtech, oferecemos oportunidades de crescimento, uma cultura guiada por valores, carreiras internacionais e a chance de moldar o futuro das experiências.

Oportunidade

Na Valtech, você encontra um ambiente projetado para aprendizado contínuo, impacto significativo e crescimento profissional. Seja criando novas soluções digitais, desafiando padrões ou construindo a próxima geração de experiências para clientes, seu trabalho ajudará a transformar indústrias.

Como Strategy Consultant Sr , você é apaixonado por inovação em experiência e motivado a expandir os limites do que é possível. Você traz 5+ anos de experiencia, mentalidade de crescimento e vontade de gerar impacto real.

Você vai se destacar nesta função se for:

  • Uma pessoa curiosa, com vontade de melhorar processos e buscar novas soluções
  • Colaborativa, que valoriza trabalho em equipe e troca de conhecimento
  • Motivada pela interseção entre tecnologia, criatividade e dados

Responsabilidades do cargo

  • Experiência com Salesforce CRM
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 3 dias remoto e 2 dias presenciais no cliente (Jacarepaguá - RJ)

Se não atender a todos os requisitos , ainda assim o incentivamos a inscrição. Na Valtech, valorizamos perfis diversos e vontade de aprender.

Nosso compromisso com todas as pessoas

Esta é uma posição CLT/PJ no BRASIL - Rio de Janeiro

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.

Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.

Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.

As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.

The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Nossa alma é de feirante: gostamos de conversar, sorrir e oferecer aquele conforto emocional das feiras livres da infância, com um atendimento próximo, humano e cheio de alegria.

Atuamos em um segmento com um jeito diferente de oferecer o frescor das feiras com a praticidade dos grandes mercados. Nosso compromisso é levar sempre até a mesa dos nossos clientes o que a natureza tem de melhor, com frutas, legumes e verduras e, assim, ajudá-los a ter uma vida mais saudável.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York, and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform food production in the tropics.
Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils, creating a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We collaborate with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are experiencing rapid growth.
Our culture emphasizes people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket symbolizes our ambition; the Heart reflects our empathy, integrity, and collective impact.
We pride ourselves on a diverse, inclusive team, primarily based in Brazil, where the climate impact is most significant. You can read reviews on Glassdoor about our interview process.

Check out our Culture page here.

About the Role

Location: Brazil (São Paulo or surrounding regions preferred)
Language Skills: Portuguese, English (fluent)
Start Date: Ideally Q3/4 2025

We seek a seasoned, strategic, and hands-on COO to lead our go-to-market strategy for mineral-based carbon removal products across agriculture and mining sectors . You will oversee our entire value chain, from mineral inputs and field operations to our science engine and technology roadmap. This senior role combines bold strategy with operational precision to scale our impact.
Your role involves refining product-market fit , identifying scalable customer use cases , and leading the integration of deployment, scientific standards, and operational scaling. You will collaborate closely with our Chief Impact Officer and Head of Operations on regional management and logistics, and with our VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and climate goals. You will ensure our product offers agronomic value and meets carbon certification standards, scaling pilots into high-impact operations at a national level.
The ideal candidate has a strong operational track record , preferably in Brazilian agribusiness , capable of bridging execution with innovation .
You will report directly to the CEO and be a key member of the Senior Leadership Team , leading a growing team including:

  • Head of Operations and project deployment teams
  • Strategic partners including the Chief Impact Officer and commercial teams
  • Close collaboration with the VP of Science
  • Coordination with Carbon and Technology teams
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a ClimateTech startup with hubs across Germany, Brazil, and the US, focusing on scaling ERW in tropical agriculture. Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating soils. We value a culture of care and excellence, with a diverse, inclusive team primarily active in Brazil. Check our Glassdoor reviews and Culture page for more insights.

About the Role

Location: Brazil (São Paulo preferred)
Language Skills: Portuguese, English
Start Date: Q3/4 2025

We seek a strategic COO to lead go-to-market efforts and operational scaling. Responsibilities include overseeing the entire value chain, ensuring product-market fit, and scaling deployment from pilots to national impact. You will work closely with senior leaders and lead a team to ensure operational excellence and scientific integrity, fostering trust with farming partners and scaling our impact.

Key ResponsibilitiesStrategy, Innovation & Scaling Operations
  • Define and scale our carbon removal product from early traction to market leader.
  • Design and execute scalable ERW deployment operations in Brazil.
  • Translate climate goals into operational strategies.
  • Improve operations through KPIs and data-driven performance.
Agricultural & Supply Chain Leadership
  • Drive go-to-market strategies, building trust with stakeholders.
  • Develop partnerships with suppliers, logistics, and regional stakeholders.
  • Oversee sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder.
  • Ensure compliance with standards and regulations.
Science-Driven Operations & Technology Alignment
  • Collaborate with science and tech teams to integrate R&D and data flows.
  • Ensure product efficacy and credibility in real-world deployment.
  • Support legal efforts for carbon reporting and impact.
Team & Culture Building
  • Build an entrepreneurial, accountable leadership culture.
  • Mentor and grow operations teams in Brazil and globally.
  • Promote a culture of collaboration and impact.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads.
Ideal Candidate Profile

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years in senior operations, supply chain, or agribusiness, especially in Brazil or high-growth/startup contexts.
  • Experience scaling from early-stage to market success, ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO.
  • Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams and scalable systems.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary yet pragmatic, balancing strategy and urgency.
  • Confident, emotionally intelligent leadership.
  • Comfort with complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, willing to get involved physically when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability and climate innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact sectors like climate or regenerative agriculture.
  • Deep network in Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic partnerships in Brazil.
  • Experience developing and scaling agricultural tech.
Our Values
  • Trust: Promote transparency and kindness.
  • Drive: Take action with urgency and purpose.
  • Impact: Aim to make a meaningful global difference.
Benefits
  • Competitive salary and transparent expectations.
  • Share options to foster ownership.
  • Home office budget, hybrid remote work (around São Paulo).
  • Personal development and language allowances.
  • 40 days of annual leave.
  • Autonomy to innovate and impact.
  • Bi-annual team offsites in Brazil.
  • Equipment such as laptops.
Compensation Philosophy

We ensure fair, equitable pay across regions, considering location, skills, and market conditions, with transparent ranges and adjustments to maintain competitiveness and fairness.

Application Process

Approximately 8 hours over 4-6 weeks, including multiple interviews, references, and profiling. Follow us on LinkedIn and subscribe to our newsletter for updates.

How to Apply
  • Submit your CV in English unless justified otherwise.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Help us shape the future of open source IT, devops, and IS, from bare metal to containers. Our goal is to revolutionise open source application and infrastructure operations.

We want to transform the world of software operations by enabling true model-driven operations via next-generation infrastructure-as-code. Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.

Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.

Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.

“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.

Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.

Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.

“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.

title: Product Director, Feegow (100% remote-friendly within Brazil)
description:
Company Description

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we\'re 100% remote-friendly.

Remote model: you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product\'s modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

What we expect from this position:

  • Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.
  • Understand a complex environment where the teams have not only individual doctors and clinics that should be delighted with their Efficiency platform, whilst bringing them new value propositions like Visibility & Growth, as well as betting on AI as a door opener for exponential value.
  • Define with PMs the product strategy on every team, how it relates to the broader Brazilian strategy & Docplanner Tech & Product strategy.
  • Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.
  • Ensure upcoming product needs and opportunities aligned with your Engineering Director and Country Managers to create a coherent Product & Tech Strategy and Roadmap.
  • Champion a hands-on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first-hand customer/user insights.
  • Create a culture of decision-making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.
  • Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.
Qualifications
  • Minimum 3 years’ work experience as Product Director / GPM (managing and coaching a group of Product Managers)
  • Experience on B2B SaaS scale-ups
  • Solid experience in fast high-growth environment, change management, & business growth
  • A proven track record of delivering significant success, scaling and developing high performing digital products that impact business & delight customers
  • Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding organizational, communicative and leadership skills
  • Business savvy, holistic business acumen outside of Product Management and ability to assess product market fit
  • Analytical abilities and problem-solving skills
  • Experience in healthcare is a plus not a must
  • Experience in modernizing tech debt whilst delivering product value is a plus
  • Hands-on: In Docplanner, being a people manager does not mean only managing people, but being able to dive in the details of problems, opportunities & solutions.
Additional Information

What will you get in return?

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills between R$37,000and R$44.500. Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;

Benefits:

  • 100% remote-friendly within Brazil
  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;
  • We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);
  • Food/Market Voucher;
  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;
  • Pet Plan;
  • iFeel app, for emotional comfort;
  • Gympass for you and up to 3 people!
  • Creditas: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;
  • Stock Options- eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period)
  • Birthday Day Off;
  • Daycare Assistance;
  • Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;
  • Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;
  • Leave of Absence/Time-off: in the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Got married? 7 days of rest! Did the baby arrive? We offer 30 days for Dads and 6 months for Moms;

Important: Docplanner is an international English-first company. Therefore, please be sure to send your CV in English

title: People Development Partner
description:
Join to apply for the People Development Partner role at Jellyfish .

Jellyfish is a full‑service global digital agency that merges strategy, creative, data, media buying and planning with technology under one integrated roof. With nearly 2,000 employees across 38 offices worldwide, we are the unconventional global marketing partner of the future.

We understand both brand and activation, ensuring clients reach, influence and connect with the right audiences. We deliver culturally relevant creativity that cuts through clutter and sets hearts (and feeds) on fire.

As part of the Brandtech Group we’re at the forefront of deploying GenAI tools. In PencilPro we host the world’s number‑one generative‑AI platform, revolutionising creative production, distribution and performance prediction.

About the Role

This People Development Partner will architect and deliver enterprise‑wide learning programs for our global workforce. You’ll focus on high‑impact programs that require consistency, quality and broad reach—leadership development, onboarding, emerging capabilities and core skills training forming the foundation of our learning ecosystem.

Reporting to the Senior People Development Partner, this role requires systems thinking, program design excellence and coordination with regional colleagues to localise programs. You’ll balance centralised design with distributed delivery, ensuring quality and regional relevance.

What You’ll Do Design & Deliver Global Leadership Development
  • Design and deliver comprehensive leadership development programs for managers worldwide.
  • Create blended learning experiences with e‑learning modules, virtual workshops, coaching and peer learning.
  • Develop core leadership curriculum covering essential management and leadership capabilities.
  • Build facilitator guides and enable regional colleagues to deliver local cohorts with consistency.
  • Leverage assessment tools to personalise leadership development and build self‑awareness.
  • Measure program impact, including behaviour change and leadership effectiveness.
  • Design a resource library of leadership tools, toolkits, templates and curated content.
Own Global Onboarding & Early Careers
  • Design and continuously improve the enterprise onboarding experience for all new hires.
  • Create role‑specific onboarding pathways for different functions and organisational levels.
  • Build onboarding e‑learning covering culture, tools, processes and compliance.
  • Coordinate with regional partners and hiring managers for consistent delivery.
  • Design early‑careers programs with clear learning pathways and development milestones.
  • Track onboarding effectiveness through feedback mechanisms and productivity metrics.
Drive Emerging Capability Development
  • Design and deliver training on emerging capabilities such as AI, digital fluency and future‑focused skills.
  • Build e‑learning curriculum on new tools and technologies relevant to various roles.
  • Partner with subject‑matter experts to identify capability priorities and training needs.
  • Facilitate hands‑on workshops providing practical application and problem‑solving.
  • Launch and support new learning tools and technologies.
  • Track capability adoption and growth through data and skills assessments.
Build Core Skills & E‑Learning Library
  • Design enterprise‑wide skills workshops on communication, productivity and professional development.
  • Build a comprehensive e‑learning library organised by role, level and skill domain.
  • Curate external content into guided learning pathways.
  • Coordinate with regional colleagues on delivery and provide facilitator guides and quality assurance.
  • Partner with subject‑matter experts to build technical and functional content.
  • Establish content governance, including review cycles, version control and lifecycle management.
Essential
  • 5-7 years in Learning & Development roles with strong program design and facilitation experience.
  • Proven track record designing and delivering large‑scale learning programs.
  • Instructional‑design expertise creating engaging, outcome‑focused learning experiences across modalities.
  • Facilitation experience with global audiences via virtual delivery.
  • E‑learning development portfolio using authoring tools.
  • Experience with leadership development programs and manager training.
  • Project‑management skills managing multiple concurrent programmes with competing deadlines.
  • Coordination skills working across matrix organisations and partnering with regional colleagues.
Desired
  • Coaching certification or experience coaching managers.
  • Experience with emerging‑technology training including AI and digital transformation.
  • Train‑the‑trainer certification or experience enabling others to facilitate.
  • Background in digital, technology or professional services industries.
  • Degree in Learning & Development, Instructional Design or related field.
Technical Capabilities
  • Instructional design methodologies and assessment design.
  • E‑learning authoring tools (Articulate Rise/Storyline, Camtasia, Adobe Captivate).
  • LMS administration and content publishing.
  • Virtual facilitation platforms and collaboration tools.
  • Video editing and multimedia content creation.
  • Learning evaluation and measurement frameworks.
Personal Attributes
  • Systems thinker who designs programmes that interconnect and see the big picture.
  • Scalability mindset, building solutions for large populations using train‑the‑trainer approaches.
  • Collaborative spirit, partnering effectively and sharing ownership generously.
  • Programme‑management capability, juggling multiple complex initiatives and delivering with quality.
  • Innovation orientation, exploring new technologies, methodologies and delivery approaches.
  • Quality obsession, maintaining high standards and representing the function with excellence.
  • Learning agility, mastering new content domains quickly and staying current on trends.
Jellyfish Values
  • We Are Real & Rigorous – cutting through noise with real analysis and brilliant rigour.
  • We Are Free‑Thinking – creating, inventing, staying curious and always challenging convention.
  • We Are All Authors – taking ownership, supporting one another and leading by example.
  • We Are One Bloom – diverse skill sets, radically collaborating for shared success.
Behaviours
  • Client‑Centric Mindset – anticipates client needs and proactively provides solutions or recommendations.
  • Ownership and Accountability – owns mistakes, identifies lessons learned and implements improvements to avoid repetition.
  • Problem‑Solving – identifies potential obstacles early and develops actionable solutions to mitigate risks.
  • Commitment to Growth and Learning – proactively seeks feedback from colleagues and clients to identify areas for improvement.
Seniority level
  • Mid‑Senior level
Employment type
  • Full‑time
Job function
  • Business Development and Sales
  • Advertising Services

description:

Descrição do Cargo

Buscamos um Líder de Migração de Dados com experiência comprovada em Utilities, responsável por definir a estratégia, governança, arquitetura e execução ponta-a-ponta da migração. É o cargo que garante precisão, integridade, rastreabilidade e estabilidade operacional do Go‑Live.

Responsabilidades
  • Definir a Data Migration Architecture para S/4HANA + IS-U, garantindo a integração de dados do CCS e sistemas legados.

  • Conduzir a migração utilizando ferramentas SAP, como Migration Cockpit e BTP/Data Services, garantindo execução precisa dos ciclos de migração, carga final e cutover data load.

title: Supervisor de Almoxarifado
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania , como caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, na prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais 20 pontos do país, atendendo a 06 estados diferentes, sendo Equipo - RJ, Itaipu - MG, Itaipu Norte - PA, Quinta Roda - SP e Supermac - AM e RR.

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos e produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com grande preocupação pela conservação do meio ambiente, as atividades produtivas são executadas visando as melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas e cuidados com as águas e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética.

Com essa aquisição, a WLM amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

A localização estratégica das unidades permite uma atuação com abrangente cobertura geográfica, garantindo presteza, qualidade e agilidade no atendimento.

A sua holding está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e possui uma filial corporativa em Minas Gerais, na Cidade de Contagem.

Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM!

Sua missão:
  • ·Supervisiona e coordena as atividades de almoxarifado.
  • Acompanha os indicadores de estoque; promove o sincronismo entre as áreas solicitantes; acompanha pedidos de fornecedores, fábrica e outros.
  • Informa sobre materiais parados no estoque para realização de promoções e outras ações de vendas.
  • Responsável por cumprir e fazer cumprir os Programas de Prevenção existentes com o objetivo de preservar a integridade física e a saúde ocupacional dos colaboradores.
  • Acompanhar e controlar a gestão do ponto e banco de horas de seus subordinados.Trabalha em conformidade com normas e procedimentos técnicos, de qualidade e de preservação do meio ambiente.
